features.description: Fix flashcard key resolution during workspace backup import in merge_skip mode so existing cards with populated subjectNames are accurately skipped.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolves subject name from backup.subjects or target map when f.subjectName is undefined.

features.description: Streamline DashboardPage.tsx into 3 scannable sections (Solar Briefing, 2-Column Core Focus & Timeline, and Compact Bottom Ribbon), eliminating scroll fatigue.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardPage consumable in under 10 seconds without vertical scroll fatigue.
Zero layout shifts on data load.
Retains 1-click Focus launch, Quick Add, and Daily Intention persistence.
features.verificationProcedure: npm run build && npx vitest run src/__tests__/phase2Consolidation.test.ts

features.description: Implement forward-looking Time Cushion algorithm comparing available weekly routine study hours with upcoming exam syllabus workload.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates surplus/deficit hours between current date and exam target date.
Renders visual cushion indicator in ExamHorizonBar and WorkloadCapacityBar.

features.description: Implement 'Never Miss Twice' habit streak protection so an isolated missed day enters a recovery state rather than resetting to 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Single missed day maintains active streak in 'Recovering' status.
Two consecutive missed days resets the streak.
All streak calculation tests in src/__tests__/streaks.test.ts pass.

features.description: Parse inline flashcard syntax (concept :: definition) in NotesPage markdown canvas to auto-index active recall cards in topic decks.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing 'Concept :: Definition' in Markdown notes auto-indexes as a flashcard linked to the subject and note.
Flashcard review decks surface inline cards seamlessly.
